title: helm: add cluster-level cost defaults (prefill/cache/quant profiles) and templates
author: Priya Shah
description:
Background: We want a safe, opinionated way to ship cluster-level defaults for batching/prefill, KV cache sizing, and quantization profiles so Managed/Private clusters can opt into Redwood Optimize presets at install time. This prevents teams from needing to hand-roll the same defaults across environments and ties chart installs into tenant-friendly unit-econ defaults.

What this PR does: Adds Helm chart-level defaults and a small templated ConfigMap that surfaces: 1) prefill/prefetch policy presets (hot/cold/tenant-weighted), 2) KV cache targets (percent-of-gpu-memory hints), 3) quantization profile stubs (fp16/int8/quant-acl presets) and 4) a small cost-mapping table used by the installer to seed tenant profiles. The values are conservative by default and documented.

Files touched (high level): updates to values.yaml (defaults block), new templates/configmap-cost-profiles.yaml, small changes to templates/deployment.yaml to expose env vars, README.md docs section and tests/values-tests.yaml.

Checklist: [x] Helm linted and fixed, [x] unit test harness for values, [x] docs updated in chart README, [x] CI smoke install on k3s cluster, [x] integration check: installer seeds tenant config.

Notes: these are installer-level defaults only; runtime still respects tenant-level overrides. This should be safe for upgrades because values are additive and the ConfigMap is created with labels that the installer can adopt. Referenced Linear: ENG-1534 (prefill defaults), ENG-1601 (quant profiles shipping).
commits: 4 commits: 1) add values.default.costProfiles and initial schema (Priya Shah), 2) new template: configmap-cost-profiles.yaml + docs (Priya Shah), 3) wire env VARS into deployment + small e2e harness (Evan Morales), 4) fix helm lint and address reviewer feedback (Lina Ortega)
files_changed: values.yaml (defaults block added), templates/configmap-cost-profiles.yaml (new), templates/deployment.yaml (env var wiring), charts/values.schema.json (schema additions), README.md (installer notes + examples), tests/values-tests.yaml (new), scripts/validate-helm.sh (small tweaks), templates/_helpers.tpl (name helper for configmap)
review_comments: Evan Morales: 'Can we keep the default KV cache as a percentage rather than absolute bytes to avoid surprises across SKU sizes?' -- Lina Ortega: 'Please add an explicit migration note for existing installs so adopters know they can opt-in.' -- Marcus Li: 'Consider adding a toggle to disable auto-seeding for stricter enterprise installs.' -- Author responses: Implemented % KV cache, added migration note to README, added values.install.seedCostProfiles: false flag and documented it. Addressed linter and naming nit. Final approval from Lina and Marcus after small fixes.
ci_checks: helm lint (fixed -> pass), chart-tests (unit values schema) pass, k3s-smoke (install/upgrade smoke succeeded on second run), e2e-installer-seed (flaky first build, rerun succeeded), security-scan (no issues). All checks green at merge.
merge_commit_message:
helm: add cluster-level cost defaults and cost-profiles configmap

Adds conservative defaults for prefill/prefetch, KV cache hints and quantization profile stubs. Includes opt-out seed flag and docs.

Linked: ENG-1534, ENG-1601
release_notes: Installer: new optional cluster defaults for batching/prefill, cache sizing, and quantization profiles. Charts expose values.default.costProfiles and values.install.seedCostProfiles (default: false). Safe opt-in; no forced runtime changes.
notes_for_operators: To enable automatic seeding at install time set values.install.seedCostProfiles=true. For private installs, you can supply your own quant profile ConfigMap by setting values.default.costProfiles.sourceConfigMap. Defaults are intentionally conservative; review quant_profile entries before enabling in high-throughput clusters.
post_merge_actions: Backfilled docs into internal installer runbook, created a Linear follow-up ENG-1628 to add tenant-aware mutation webhook to validate profiles at runtime, added an item for QA to run a dedicated throughput test with int8 profile enabled.
ff_compatibility: This change is backward compatible: default values are additive and installer will not overwrite user-supplied ConfigMaps when seedCostProfiles=false. Upgrades will create new ConfigMap with unique name if none exists.
testing_summary: Local helm template checks + chart-tests validated schema. k3s smoke tested install and upgrade flows. Installer e2e verified that when seed flag is enabled, tenant gets seeded with a lightweight cost profile. Load-sensitive quant profiles were not enabled in e2e for safety; follow-up ENG-1628 is to add gated performance tests.
maintainer_notes: Chart owners should coordinate a minor chart version bump and announce the new opt-in defaults in the release notes to avoid surprising enterprise customers. Security team verified configmap content is non-secretable and uses RBAC-safe annotations.
